description: This file defines the JsonArray interface, which models an immutable JSON array with methods for creation, modification, and access to JSON array data. It includes static factory methods for constructing JsonArray instances from strings, iterables, or arrays of values, as well as default methods for building and extending JSON arrays.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonArray from a JSON string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonArray containing specified values, inferring appropriate JsonValue types.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JsonArray from an Iterable of values, converting each to JsonValue.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new JsonArrayBuilder for building JSON arrays.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder pre-initialized with data from this array for modifications.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new JsonArray with the specified value appended, for numeric types.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new JsonArray with the specified boolean value appended.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new JsonArray with the specified string value appended.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Returns a new JsonArray with the specified JsonValue appended.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specified index, if present.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks whether the array contains a specific JsonValue.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the first index of a specified JsonValue.
